notes.title: Update - EA-version 3.1 - Pickup-truck, faster looting and building and more
notes.content: [h1]Update - EA-version 3.1 - Pickup-truck, faster looting and building and a lot more![/h1][p][/p][p]Hello folks! Another update is finally here. Main focus has been vehicles but I have worked with a lot of other things too. This update mostly consists of the following:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Pickup-truck[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Rag-crafting fixed[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Faster looting[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Faster building[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed quick placing and placing - [b]quick placing is on middle mouse button (MMB)[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]More animal spawn points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]More Soldiers[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed so that consuming consumables via hotbars doesn't disrupt firearms magazine[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Lights to vehicles[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Better and bigger roads[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed several bugs related to vehicles[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Bug where could get wet inside car when it was raining is fixed[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Lose the car if drive it into the water[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Sometimes weird angle on chests lid and fridge doors - fixed[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Some sounds left on the spot where something noisy was standing after moving it - fixed[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Spikewall trap got triggered directly after placing it - fixed[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Quick-move with middle mouse button is now official[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]You can now run enemies over with cars[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]General level design[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Rag bug erased, Pickup-truck and faster crafing
notes.content: [h3][u]This week I will release a new update with tons of fixes and new stuff![/u][/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]The update consists of the following additions and fixes:[/p][list][*][p][b]Rag-crafting fixed!!![/b][/p][/*][/list][p]- As I was going through the crafting system for the last update I was expanding the system since more and more items are added to the game and I used the rags to test something on. Unfortunately I forgot to erase the change I made to the rag-crafting and the result was that you weren't able to craft rags anymore.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Pickup-truck[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Faster looting[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Faster building[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Quick-placing with middle mouse button is now official[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]More animal spawn points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]More Soldiers[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed so that consuming consumables via hotbars doesn't disrupt firearms magazine[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Lights to vehicles[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Better and bigger roads[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed several bugs related to vehicles[/p][/*][*][p]Run enemies over with cars[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Bug where you could get wet inside a car when it was raining[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Lose the car if you drive it into the water (so try to avoid driving your car into a lake)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Sometimes weird angle on chests lid and fridge doors[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Some sounds left on the spot where something noisy was standing after moving it[/p][/*][*][p]Spikewall trap got triggered directly after placing it[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]General level design[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update EA 3.0
notes.content: [p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p][/p][p]I have been working quite a bit on bringing forward a new update and finally it's time![/p][p]The biggest changes with this update are:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Roads[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Cars[/b] - with inventory that you can find in the world. If you find the right car parts you can fix it and drive around the Evil mountains in it.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Gas stations[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]New enemy: soldier - they shoot at you so be really careful![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Tunnel[/p][p][/p][p][b]New items:[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Gasoline[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Car engine[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Car battery[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Car wheel[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Sparkplugs[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Hatchback[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug fixes and improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Optimization[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improved fishing mechanics[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Armor bug where you kept armor from armor pieces that the player equipped even when you lost the armor pieces through death or destruction. All players that got a higher armor than what was supposed to will also have their armor tuned down to normal levels.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A bug where you tried to pick up an item but changed your mind and thereafter tried to loot a drawer then you picked up that very same item.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Anomalies like wound infection, bleeding etc. still showed up in the status menu after you died[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Removed not being able to move while bandaging[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Other things I have been working on is level design. [b]A new area with a big forest[/b] is now in place. More lakes. More variations in the birds singing.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: 2025-05-22 Patch - Reduced UFO encounters
notes.content:
* Reduced amount of UFOs and Blobs and also made it so they will not spawn every day
* Severely reduced probability of UFOs attacking player base

notes.title: 2025-05-16 Patch - Fixed quickslot firearm ammo bug and more
notes.content:
* Fixed an issue where the player picked up an extra flashlight after loading a save when player was wearing a flashlight
* Fixed an issue where the fuel level in the generator appeared to be 0 when the generator wasn't connected to the power terminal
* Fixed a bug where the ammo in firearms didn't got saved correctly if you reloaded a firearm that you had on a quickslot and then switched to another quickslot and switched back again

notes.title: 2025-05-08 EA version 2 - Electricity system
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It's been a while since the last update. I have been working on a new electricity system and that's what has kept me busy. I hope you like it!

* [b]A new electricity system implemented[/b]
 - Power terminal - crafted at the workbench. You can only craft 1. The power terminal is needed in order to hook your electrical devices together
- Powerbank - crafted at the workbench. You can only craft 1. A storage unit for electricity with unlimited capacity
- Solar panels - produces electricity during daytime. Make sure they are not covered from above so the sunlight is able to reach them

* [b]Flashlight + batteries to recharge it[/b]

* Level design - filled the world with more lootables
                       - general level design

* Bug fixes

notes.title: 2025-04-15 Mining drill and bug fixes
notes.content:
* Now you can build a [b]mining drill[/b]. You craft it at the blacksmith's bench. It's powered by electricity and it produces all kinds of ores.
* Fixed a bug that made the [b]water collector[/b] not collecting water. So now the water collector actually collects water during rain, as it's supposed to.
* Fixed some minor issues regarding the shovel

notes.title: 2025-04-06 Repair bench and fixes
notes.content:
Good evening survivors!
Another update for Evil mountains is now released. The major parts I have been working with since the last update are:
* You can now craft a [b]repair bench[/b]. With this you can repair all your items.
* Made some minor adjustments in the crafting code
* Fixed issues related to swapping items with the hotbars

notes.title: 2025-04-02 Plantbeds major overhaul
notes.content: Reworked some of the systems concerning the plantbed functionality. I also got a chance to rework a couple of closely related systems as well. Before this update plants in the plantbed vanished if they were fully grown and the player saved and exit the game. The problem is now fixed.

notes.title: 2025-03-31 Minor fix
notes.content: * Fixed the recipe part in the crafting benches where the amount for the ingredients in the crafting benches weren't shown correctly

notes.title: 2025-03-30 Update - Multicrafting and bug fixes
notes.content:
Hi! I'm continuing working with the game, developing it further and fixing bugs. Thanks for all the bug reports! Here are the latest fixes and additions:

* [b]Added multicrafting[/b] of some basic items
* Logsled issues fixed - fixed so doesn't "flip out" (and sometimes get lost) when running over 
                                       bushes/plants
                                    - fixed so can't climp ropes while log sledding
* Shelter marker save - fixed
* Made so not infestations every day
* Fixed infestation issues regarding didn't got saved properly. That markers of infestations actually mark infestations etc.
* Fixed so can pick up spikewall trap, dynamite trap and molotov trap
* Fixed so doesn't reset water level in the plant bed if player does'nt have any water and trying to add water
* Fixed so water collector will fill properly after it's emptied
* Fixed so player doesn't lose planks if trying to pick up from plankholder and inventory is full
* fixed so player doesn't lose anything after producing something with the sawbench and there's not enough room in inventory
* Fixed so cannot pick up stationaries if the inventory is full
* Changed variations in enemy type when base attacks

notes.title: 2025-03-26 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
I want to start by saying thank you to all I have gotten constructive feedback from, it surely is appreciated!  With the help and inspiration from you guys I continue developing Evil mountains with great passion!


Todays update includes:

* Lighting the torch standing next to a campfire issue is fixed
* Put some instructions on how to turn the gokart engine on and off (it's L Ctrl) on the HUD (that will 
   appear when you sit down on the vehicle)
* All the lakes can be interacted with now (I missed some lakes in a previous update)
* Day counting is fixed (unfortunately everyone will start from day 0 from here). Since respawning of 
   plants and respawning of loot in lootables (drawers for example) is dependent upon the day counting 
   that part of the game also works now.
* I have been making changes to the weather system and I hope the variations in weather will work 
   now but it needs some testing before I can be sure about that. Please send me reports if it doesn't 
   seem to work and please give me as much details as possible (how long have you played, what 
   weather type it is, how long has it been the same type of weather etc.)
* Motion blur is now removed. If you want it to be optional, please let me know (even though I 
   probably will make it optional later on).
* Reduced food and water loss after sleeping

notes.title: Extra info about the fixes to the save system
notes.content:
Hi!
I have gotten reports about that some items that's placed on the ground don't get saved.
To get rid of the long loading times for players where too much actors had been saved in the world I had to flush certain type of actors to make sure I got everything covered. The actors affected by this are the ones of types resources, oral medicals and food items. The flushing happens for everyone that had save files between 2025-03-09 to 2025-03-24. And it only affects actors of those types that are placed on the ground. So everything in chests will not get affected. [b]From tomorrow (25th of march) there will be no more flushing of those actors [/b] so from then every type of item you place on the ground will get saved again.

notes.title: 2025-03-23 - Long loading time-issue finally fixed!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I finally figured out where in the code the problems to the long loading times for players that had played the game for a while were. The reason was that foliage didn't got destroyed  after interacting with it but turned into actors. Almost all the actors in the world get saved. Since the foliage returned after loading in and when the player interacted with it again another actor got spawned into the world. Over time that led to an accumulation of actors in the world. The longer you played, the more actors existed in the world. But now the problem is fixed, HOWEVER: the first time you load in after this update might take long to finish until all the old structs that contains the info for the accumulated actors are flushed. ALSO: All resources, plants and mushrooms that aren't foliage will get flushed.

The update includes:
* Fixed long loading time-issue
* "floating" enemy clothing in the world is solved
* Made some adjustments to the progression of enemy encounters

I'm really thankful for all the feedback I have gotten and a big thank you to the player who finally made me see where the problem was.

Take care!

That problem is fixed now with this update. However, the building parts that wre lost will not return I'm afraid. But new building parts will be saved correctly from no on. If you had a save file with building parts in it you can send me your save file to kraftverksoftworks@gmail.com so I can see if I can reconstruct your buildables. Hello everyone! I have worked on some bugs that I have been aware about from some players, here are the main things I have been doing:

notes.content:

notes.title: Hotfix and contact-details
notes.content:
Hi! Now it's finally out there in early access. I hope you enjoy Evil mountains and that you don't encounter too many irritating bugs. I try my best to fix bugs and I constantly run into such but hopefully I get help from you guys when it comes to bugs, balancing and that I get all kinds of input and wishes.

My official e-mail is: [b]kraftverksoftworks@gmail.com[/b]
Right now I have'nt got the discord-page up and running but I will get into it soon. In the meantime you can e-mail me and I will reply as soon as I can.


Fixes:
* Disabled ability to change global illumination and changed it to medium since larger values makes certain areas look to dark

* Added bug report button in pause menu

* Fixed so that inventory updates properly after detaching items from the character

* Fixed so firearms on a specific hotbar loose its stored ammo if you empty the ammo on the weapon on hand and that happens to be the weapon on that specific hotbar

notes.title: 2024-05-11 - Bug fixes
notes.content:
[b]Fixed issue with dropping items when swapping out a hotbar item with another when inventory is full[/b].
- The issue was that when you had a full inventory and attempted to swap something in your hotbar with something in your inventory the item was swapped but the item that should go back to inventory instead dropped since the inventory had'nt registered the removal of the item from the inventory before it attempted to accept the item from the hotbar.

[b]Fixed Select amount menu sometimes not disappearing[/b] - The issue occured when dropping loot if attempting to drop several items at the same time.

[b]Fixed an issue with not being able to close the chest menu until you clicked somewhere on the screen[/b]
- The issue occured when transferring something because the select amount menu "stole" the focus after interacting with it and did'nt hand it back to the parent menu when you were done transferring until you clicked somewhere on the screen.

notes.title: 2024-05-07 - Larger interact hit box
notes.content:
Hey folks!

On request I increased the size of the hitbox when interacting with objects. I hope you like it!

At the moment I'm working on a new level that is actually the first level I created for the game. It is already filled with more content/POIs than the present level. Hopefully everyone will like it when I release it.

Cheers!
/Karl

notes.title: 2024-05-02 - Bug fix
notes.content:
I'm sorry to say that a bug has been detected that's related to the demo and the saving of buildables. The result was first that the demoscreen appeared soon after the second time you loaded into the world. It also made that the buildables didn't got saved.

I have fixed the issue now, but unfortunately: if you had been building something using the base building menu, your buildables will be lost. Moreover, [u]if you had that issue of the demo end screen appearing to soon, you have to delete the save file called "BuildSave.sav"[/u] which can be found in the folder c:/user/[your user name]/AppData/Local/AboveAndUnder.
I hope this did'nt cause to much trouble for anyone.

/Karl

notes.title: Bug with demo screen showing up too soon

I also forgot to post some more changes I made to the game in the previous main update:

 - You will get more branches from cutting down trees and bushes.

- You are able to cut down trees and bushes with knifes now.
